findings.body: FORGE-STEER-1 appears in this spec but is absent from `plans/roadmap.json`, whose items end at line 68. The spec's Roadmap section does not register it: `src/forge/records.py:292-295` separately writes and commits roadmap entries, and `src/forge/story.py:95-96` refuses to start a story absent from that registry. Run `forge roadmap add codex-steering` and include the resulting roadmap change. This directly required step can be completed on this branch.
